task: Frozen-spectrum soft-background return-branch diagnostic; no new complete model fit
inverse: One-dimensional monotone inversion of the fixed negative-polarity log-current table, scaled only by original_Ron/common_Ron. Use full existing table support, no extension. Verify used inverse points against fixed spectral quadrature without refitting.
fraction_scope: 0.5 and 0.9 are explicit hypothetical lower bounds on background fraction for sensitivity only, not measured confidence bands. At 1.0 the inverse is the effective pure-soft equality; for unknown nonnegative parallel path it is only an upper bound on Gamma.
static_diagnostic: Compute per-record and pooled maximum uniformly guaranteed background fraction compatible with one static Gamma and nonnegative path; do not fit a static Gamma.
monotone_diagnostic: Use cumulative minima of effective Gamma upper bounds to test existence of nonincreasing Gamma along return and calculate the greatest compatible lower background fraction.
minimal_dynamics_screen: Only derive feasible beta intervals for d ln Gamma/ds = -beta*abs(V), beta>=0, s in path volts. On return D=0.5*(2.5^2-v^2). Apply pairwise interval inequalities; no beta scan or optimization. Initial Gamma is allowed inside observed apex intervals only as a necessary-condition relaxation, never as a predictive initialization.
tail_gate: Invert only the original aggregate return 0.2 V feature interval, with additive-path versus pure-soft meanings kept separate.
budget_start: After input loading, hash checks, source/plan manifest and selected array extraction; includes inversion, diagnostics, and direct spectral evaluation.
forbidden: initializing a forward model from its own return tail
inferring seconds or temperature from voltage steps
